significance: A Paadal Petra Sthalam sung in the Tevaram, its masonry attributed to the 10th-century Cholas and carrying inscriptions from the reign of Uttama Chola recording tax-free grants for festivals and upkeep.
story: Agni, the fire god, is said to have worshipped Shiva at this spot, which is why the presiding deity is called Agnipureeswarar.
